name: Baranyaszentgyörgy (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of white with two horizontal bands of red and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Baranyaszentgyörgy (a blue shield with Saint George slaying the dragon) within a yellow wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
